title: Head of the Family (miniquest)
start: Talk to the Waiko moai on the hill north-east of Waiko market.

rewards.t: Moai decoration available in Waiko Reward Shop
An additional crew member, Cap'n Ekahi

steps.t: Talk to the Waiko moai on the hill north-east of Waiko (if you have just completed Impressing the Locals you may need to relog for the chat options to appear). [Chat: Accept › 1 Hello. Who are you? › 4 Farewell.]
Charter a ship to Aminishi (Use Quartermaster Gully).
Run north along the west coast and talk to Aminishi moai.
Sail back to Waiko and talk to Rosie in the north-west section of the marketplace. Don't buy any supplies.
Run south-east past the bamboo stalks and talk to Yuehanxun the Dealer. Confirm the payment of 15 fish oil.
Sail to Whale's Maw and on the north-west coast, talk to Sea Witch Kaula. [Chat: 3 Tell me of the moai that travelled on water.]
Return to Rosie for a soil bag. Don't buy any supplies.
Sail to Aminishi and fill the bag on the beach.
Return to Rosie (with filled bag, 5 bamboo, and 150 chimes) and confirm the payment. Don't buy any supplies.
Sail to Aminishi, run east and talk to Cap'n Ekahi. Confirm the payment of 300 chimes.
Talk to Aminishi moai, north of your ship.
Travel by the Rowboat next to Cap'n Ekahi on Aminishi.
Enable deflect Melee and defeat the 3 cyclopes. There is a safespot behind the mast.
Return to Waiko moai where you started the quest.

get_inside.text: Players can travel to Waiko by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals. The Arc journal is an easy way to get to Quartermaster Gully.
Waiko teleports, purchased from Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes, can be broken to teleport the player to the merchant hub on Waiko.
